blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
A new concept, termed virtual neural networks, is introduced, where the count of trainable parameters is kept constant, and scalability is attained purely through computational resources. This concept is an abstract framework that can be realized using any standard convolutional neural network. It merges siamese neural networks with a deep ensemble technique by generating numerous virtual models that share weights derived from a small set of physical models. The ensemble comprises up to hundreds of trained models simultaneously. All virtual networks take the same input, and their interconnected structure induces an internal distortion that boosts the entire ensemble robustness. The accuracy of the ensemble improves as the number of virtual networks increases, without changing the capacity. Virtual neural networks outperform larger capacity models, typical deep ensembles, and contemporary approaches like SWA and Masksembles. Additionally, the highest-performing individual model from the ensemble surpasses other models trained individually, even those with a greater number of parameters.
Code: gitlab.com/EnginCZ/virtual-models-public Keywords: ensemble, siamese network, model diversity, deep learning.
blocks.zh:
引入了一个称为虚拟神经网络的新概念,即可训练参数的计数保持不变,而可扩展性完全通过计算资源实现。 这个概念是一个抽象的框架,可以使用任何标准进化神经网络来实现. 它将暹罗神经网络与深层综艺技术融合在一起,产生出众多的虚拟模型,这些模型共享从一小组物理模型中衍生出来的权重. 综艺节目由多达数百个训练有素的模特同时组成. 所有虚拟网络都采用相同的输入,其互联结构诱发内部扭曲,提升整个综艺的稳健性. 综艺的精度随着虚拟网络数量的增加而提高,而不改变容量. 虚拟神经网络超越了更大的容量模型,典型的深层综艺,以及SWA和Masksemble等当代方法. 此外,综艺节目中表现最出色的个人模型超过了其他单独培训的模型,即使是那些参数较多的模型。

blocks.en: 1 Related work
blocks.zh: 1 相关工作

blocks.en:
Ensembling. Training and testing costs are one of the most important constraints for ensembles. To address this issue, various approaches have been proposed.
LegoNet [ 14 ] uses lightweight filters that are combined into standard-size filters that share the parameters. FGE [ 15 ] uses the fact that the surface of a complex loss function is connected by curves over which training and test accuracy are nearly constant and proposes an implicit set of models on the same path between nodes. To avoid the FGE’s issue of increasing the computation time of inference due to making inference of n n models, SWA [ 16 ] stores model’s weights during the n n last epoch and averages them into a single model. Wand et al. [ 17 ] showed that such averaging can be used efficiently with weight pruning. The implicit ensemble of SWA is changed to explicit in SWAP [ 18 ] by training several models in parallel and averaging their weights after several epochs repeatedly. A similar idea of the implicit ensemble is proposed in [ 19 ] where a model is trained using the cyclic learning rate [ 20 ] , its weights (snapshots) are stored before the learning rate is restarted, and then the stored weights are averaged. Compared to SWA, the Snapshot ensemble weights are more diverse. Diversity refers to the situation in which individual models within an ensemble disagree when they are incorrect and do not consistently predict the same class. Given two ensembles with the same accuracy, the one with greater model diversity is more useful, as this diversity can be leveraged to measure the uncertainty of the ensemble.
The heterogeneous explicit ensemble is used in [ 21 ] , where the outputs of several models are passed through shared layers to produce the final output (module) for each model. The modules are then assembled. Takahashi et al. [ 22 ] takes a base network and creates two copies of it. The copies share weights and are continuously downsampled by factor 2 to the input resolution. The aggregated outputs are used to make the final prediction. Havasi et al. [ 23 ] use the MIMO approach, in which by feeding a network with n n various images and taking n n outputs, the network must create subnets internally. During testing, only one image is used, copied n n times, and the output is averaged. They found that the ideal number of subnetworks is about 2-3 only.
blocks.zh:
摄受. 培训和测试费用是制约综艺节目的最重要因素之一。 为了解决这一问题,提出了各种办法。
乐高网 [14] 使用轻量级滤波器,这些滤波器被组合成共享参数的标准大小滤波器. FGE [15] 使用一个复杂的损失函数的表面通过曲线连接,在曲线上训练和测试精度几乎不变,并在节点之间的同一路径上提出一套隐含的模型. 为避免FGE由于nn模型推论而增加推论计算时间的问题,SWA[16]在n上个纪元期间将模型的权重存储起来,并把它们平均成一个单一模型. 华德等. [17] 显示,这种平均率可以随着体重的推移而得到有效利用。 全部门办法中隐含的组合改为在全部门办法[18]中明确,办法是同时培训若干模型,并在几个时代之后反复平均其重量。 在[19]中提出了类似隐含的综艺概念,即使用循环学习速率[20]训练一个模型,其权重(snapshots)在重新开始学习速率之前存储,然后存储权重平均. 与SWA相比,Snapshot综艺的重量更为多样. 多样性是指一个综艺节目中单个模型在不正确且无法一致预测同一类时出现分歧的情况. 鉴于两个组合的准确性相同,模型多样性较大的组合更为有用,因为可以利用这种多样性来衡量组合的不确定性。
在[21]中使用了各式各样的显式组合,若干模型的输出通过共享层传递,为每个模型产生最终输出(模块). 然后组装模块。 高桥等. [22]取一个基网并创建其两本. 复制品共享权重,并按输入分辨率的因数2持续下取样. 总产出用于作出最后预测。 哈瓦西等人著. [23] 采用MIMO方法,通过给一个网络输入n各种图像并获取n的输出,网络必须内部创建子网. 在测试中,只使用一个图像,复制nn次,输出平均. 他们发现子网络的理想数量只有2-3左右.

blocks.en: A specific loss function for the ensemble is tackled by negative correlation learning [ 24 ] , generalized and negative correlation learning [ 9 ] , evaluation of cross-entropy between the ensembled models [ 25 ] , the addition of Kullback-Leibler diversity [ 26 ] , or by incorporating both diversity and cooperation losses at the same time [ 27 ] . The issue of the described ensemble is that all models in the ensemble are trained jointly; it leads to increase of of memory requirements and does not allow train big ensembles.
blocks.zh: 综艺的一个具体损失功能是通过负相关学习[24],泛相关和负相关学习[9],综艺模型间交叉交替性评价[25],加入Kullback-Leibler diversity[26],或者同时纳入多样性和合作损失[27]. 所描述的综艺节目的问题在于综艺节目中的所有型号都是联合训练的;它导致内存要求的增加,不允许列车大型综艺节目.

blocks.en: The entire research direction is devoted to dropout [ 28 , 29 ] as a form of the ensemble technique and a representative of pseudo-ensemble class [ 30 ] . The class is characterized by a parent model, from which the child models are sampled with respect to a certain noise type. Monte Carlo dropout, as employed by Gal et al. [ 31 ] , allows dropout to be applied during inference. To control the process of generating subnetworks, Durasov et al. [ 32 ] create random dropout subnetworks by defining fixed dropout masks at the beginning of training and making predictions using the models given by the masks. Kobayashi et al. [ 33 ] and Liu et al. [ 34 ] call the models created by a mask as ticket and show that from a pre-trained model, a diversified ensemble can be established by involving distinct tickets. Masks can also be created in a guided scheme to obtain non-overlapping subnetworks [ 35 ] . The disadvantages of this research direction are the decreased capacity of the base network and the increased computation time during inference. The crucial decision is how to select the appropriate dropout rate: the subnetworks are too similar, and the diversity is low when the dropout rate is low. When the dropout rate is higher, capacity is reduced, particular subnetworks perform worse, and thus the performance of the ensemble is also lower.
blocks.zh: 整个研究方向都针对退学[28,29],作为综艺技术的一种形式和伪综艺类的代表[30]. 班级以家长模式为特点,儿童模式对某种噪音类型进行抽样。 Gal等人雇用的Monte Carlo辍学案[31]允许在推断期间适用辍学案。 为了控制子网络的生成过程,Durasov等人. [32]通过在培训开始时定义固定的辍学口罩,并利用口罩给出的模型进行预测,创建随机辍学子网络. 小林等[33],刘等. [34] 将面具创造的模型称为票,并表明从经过预先训练的模型中,可以通过涉及不同门票的方式建立多样化的综艺节目. 也可以在制导计划中创建遮罩,以获得非重叠子网络[35]. 这一研究方向的缺点是基网容量下降,推论期间计算时间增加. 关键的决定是如何选择适当的辍学率:子网络过于相似,在辍学率低时多样性较低。 当辍学率较高时,容量下降,特定的子网络表现更差,因此综艺节目的性能也更低.

blocks.en: Siamese neural network . The original idea [ 36 , 13 ] is based on several identical neural networks that fully share weights and are trained to produce similar latent representations for similar inputs and vice versa, i.e., its aim is semantic similarity. Learning is carried out using a simple Euclidean / cosine distance or contrastive loss [ 37 ] . In the area of image processing, applications include the recognition of signatures [ 36 ] , faces [ 38 ] , or gestures [ 39 ] , to name a few. Some publications [ 40 , 41 ] focus on the assembly of siamese neural networks, but are restricted to the standard task of matching latent representations. BatchEnsemble [ 42 ] shares weights between all members of the ensemble, which are taken and multiplied by vectors whose weights are private for a certain member. Such a scheme saves the required memory due to shared main weights.
blocks.zh: 暹罗神经网. 最初的想法[36,13]是基于几个完全共享权重的完全相同的神经网络,并且经过训练,可以为类似的输入产生类似的潜在表达,反之亦然,即它的目标是语义相似. 学习使用简单的Euclidean / 余弦距离或对比性损失[37]. 在图像处理领域,申请包括承认签名[36],面额[38],或手势[39],仅举几个例子. 一些出版物[40,41]侧重于暹罗神经网络的集合,但仅限于匹配潜在表达的标准任务. Batch Ensemble [42] 在综艺的所有成员之间分享权重,这些权重被取而代之的是矢量,对于某个成员来说其权重是私人的. 由于共享主重,这样的方案可以保存所需的内存.

blocks.en: The proposed technique, VNNE, combines the siamese neural network approach with a deep ensemble. A novel partial siamese neural network is introduced, consisting of virtual models that are mutually tangled and share the weight space of the physical models; see Figure 1 . Unlike a typical siamese network, the network output is not a latent representation but class probabilities collectively aggregated by a non-trainable aggregation layer in the final ensemble prediction. The aggregation layer, which lacks trainable parameters, enables the selection of a single virtual network from a trained VNNE for use as a standalone standard model.
blocks.zh: 拟议的技术VNNE结合了暹罗神经网络方法与深层综艺. 引入了一个新的部分暹罗神经网络,由虚拟模型组成,它们相互缠绕,并共享物理模型的重量空间;见图1. 与典型的暹罗网络不同,网络输出并不是一种潜伏的表示,而是类概率在最终的综艺预测中被一个不可训练的聚合层集体汇总. 集成层缺乏可训练参数,因此能够从经过训练的VNNE中选择一个单一的虚拟网络作为独立的标准模型使用.

blocks.en: VNNE vs ensembles . VVNE is not a traditional ensemble method. 1) Subnetworks are not created by reducing the parameters of a single base network (e.g., through dropout or masks); instead, all subnetworks maintain the same number of parameters as the base network. 2) The overall ensemble size grows while the memory required for training increases sublinearly. 3) All subnetworks are optimized jointly. 4) At any stage of optimization, all subnetworks are ready for use.
blocks.zh: VNNE vs 综艺节目. VVNE不是传统的综艺方法. 1)子网络不是通过减少单个基网的参数(例如通过退出或口罩)来创建的;而是所有子网络维持与基网相同的参数数. 2) 总体综艺体积增加,而训练所需的内存则会分线增加. 3)所有子网络联合优化. 4)在任何优化阶段,所有子网络都准备使用.

blocks.en: 2 Virtual neural networks ensemble (VNNE)
blocks.zh: 2 虚拟神经网络综艺(VNNE).

blocks.en:
In an ensemble of models, the key principle in achieving good performance is the diversity between the involved models [ 12 , 43 ] , where the diversity itself can be an optimization criterion during the training procedure [ 35 ] . Diversity refers to a low correlation between the produced probabilities. While an ensemble of models enhances generalization, it also results in increased size and reduced computational speed. In various competitions on platforms such as Kaggle and Signate, ensembles often consist of more than ten models, making them unsuitable for deployment in end-user applications.
Motivated by the work described in [ 32 , 35 , 23 ] , where a single base network includes subnetworks, this study explores a scheme that incorporates multiple base networks to combine the advantages of traditional deep ensembles [ 6 ] and the theory of subnetworks.
blocks.zh:
在一系列模型中,实现良好业绩的关键原则是所涉模型之间的多样性[12,43],在培训过程中,多样性本身可以成为优化标准[35]。 多样性是指产生的概率之间的低相关性. 虽然一个模型组合可以增强泛化,但也会导致大小增大,计算速度降低. 在Kaggle和Signate等平台上的各种比赛中,综艺节目往往包括十多种模式,因此不适合在最终用户应用中部署.
以[32,35,23]所述工作为动力,一个单一基网包括子网,本研究探索一个将多个基网融合在一起的计划,以结合传统深层综艺的优点[6]和子网理论.

blocks.en: In a box, the main principle of VNNE is to build subnetworks from the parts of the base networks. First, a basic architecture (e.g., ResNet) is chosen and split into a logical sequence of disjoint blocks where a block is represented by a single or multiple layers. Then, several standard neural networks (called physical ) are created as usual with respect to the architecture. Finally, the derived networks (called virtual ) are constructed as follows. For every block of every virtual network in the architecture, the corresponding block is taken from the randomly selected physical network (see Figure 1 ). The final VNNE is loaded into the GPU at once and all virtual networks are trained jointly. This means that the diversity of models is a natural product of the training procedure if needed. In other words, the process of creation put the weights of the physical layers into the memory. So, when virtual neural networks are created, the layers with their weights already exist in memory, and the composition of VNNES establishes logical connections between these weights. When multiple VNNE share the same weight, this weight is not duplicated. The following section describes the whole construction procedure in more detail.
blocks.zh: 在一个框中,VNNE的主要原理是从基网部分建立子网络. 首先,选择一个基本架构(如ResNet),并分成一个由单层或多层代表的块的逻辑序列. 然后,一些标准神经网络(称为物理网络)就建筑而言是照常创建的. 最后,衍生的网络(称为虚拟)构建如下. 对于架构中每一个虚拟网络的每个块,相应的块都取自随机选择的物理网络(见图1). 最终的VNNE即刻加载到GPU中,所有虚拟网络都被联合训练. 这意味着模型的多样性是培训程序的自然产物。 换句话说,创作的过程将物理层的权重放入内存. 因此,当虚拟神经网络被创建时,带有其权重的层已经在内存中存在,VNNES的构成在这些权重之间建立了逻辑联系. 当多个VNNE共享相同重量时,此重量不重复. 下一节更详细地说明整个施工程序。

blocks.en: 2.1 Construction of virtual neural networks ensemble
blocks.zh: 2.1 建立虚拟神经网络联合体

A physical neural network used for weight sharing in virtual networks can be formalized as a mapping of a three-dimensional tensor to a one-dimensional vector. For simplicity, we omit batch dimension and consider the task of classifying images into ℓ \ell classes, but VNNE can also be adapted for image segmentation, image detection, image generation, etc.

Each network operates as a function P i : ℝ h × w × 3 → ℝ ℓ P_{i}:\mathbb{R}^{h\times w\times 3}\to\mathbb{R}^{\ell} , where a standard raster color image of resolution h × w h\times w is considered as input.
Moreover, each of the physical networks consists of b > 0 b>0 blocks , that is, P i = { B i , 1 , B i , 2 , … , B i , b } P_{i}=\{B_{i,1},B_{i,2},\dots,B_{i,b}\} . Here, we suppose that a block is an abstract structure whose internal composition is given by a particular neural network architecture.

blocks.en: Furthermore, we consider that both virtual networks involve the block B 2 , 2 B_{2,2} . This means that the block refers to the same physical weights, and therefore the weights between virtual networks are shared, identical, and updated by both virtual blocks with the same priority. Because it is the last block of our simple network and produces the probabilities (we here omit the aggregation layer for simplicity), the network is trained to produce B 1 , 2 ​ ( 𝐗 ′ ) ≈ B 2 , 2 ​ ( 𝐗 ′′ ) ≈ 𝐘 B_{1,2}(\mathbf{X^{\prime}})\approx B_{2,2}(\mathbf{X^{\prime\prime}})\approx\mathbf{Y} . In other words, the block B 1 , 2 B_{1,2} is trained to accept two different sets of feature maps (produced by the same data and various preceding blocks) and to produce the same prediction. This forces the block B 2 , 2 B_{2,2} to have its internal weights robust enough with respect to perturbations in its input, i.e., the inner combination. Note that the described scheme is similar to multi-path blocks in ResNeXt [ 46 ] with the difference that ResNeXt does not use shared weights and utilizes the aggregation layer after each block. In our case, we share weights among random blocks, realize inner aggregation by putting multiple outputs from distinct physical blocks into one randomly, and have only one fixed aggregation layer at the end of our ensemble.

We hypothesize that such inner combination of feature maps leads to the production of more robust weights to process more general feature maps, which decrease overfitting and thus improve the performance of such a model.

blocks.en: 2.5 Collapsing into the same network?
blocks.zh: 2.5 撞入同一个网络?

blocks.en: Speaking in terms of general neural networks, we mark as collapsed such a state, where ∀ ( i , i ′ ) : B i , j W = B i ′ , j W \forall(i,i^{\prime}):B^{W}_{i,j}=B^{W}_{i^{\prime},j} , for an arbitrary j j and where B i , j W B^{W}_{i,j} denotes weights of the block. Speaking of the ensemble, we are more interested in outputs than in weights, so we define a collapsed state as ∀ ( i , i ′ ) : V i ​ ( ⋅ ) = V i ′ ​ ( ⋅ ) \forall(i,i^{\prime}):V_{i}(\cdot)=V_{i^{\prime}}(\cdot) . To express the inverse degree of collapse, the Kullback-Leibler diversity ( d K ​ L d_{KL} ) [ 34 ] can be used. We suppose three possible scenarios: S1 : d K ​ L d_{KL} will decrease through training until it is equal to zero, i.e., all virtual networks will collapse into a single network. S2 : d K ​ L d_{KL} will decrease, but the decrease will eventually stop. A further decrease in divergence would lead to an increase in the loss of the whole ensemble, and this prevents it from collapsing. S3 : d K ​ L d_{KL} will first decrease, stabilize at some point, and increase until an equilibrium is reached. Here, the increase is supposed to be the only case in which the performance of the ensemble increases when increasing the performance of particular networks does not lead to further improvement in the loss. These three scenarios are visualized in Figure 3 . We empirically estimated real progress by training VNNE for two physical and 20 virtual NNs with aggregation by multiplication and measuring d K ​ L d_{KL} after each epoch of training on CIFAR-10 classification task. The results given by the graph in Figure 3 show that it converges to an equilibrium similar to S2, that is, a stable state without collapsing.

blocks.en: In the area of deep neural networks, there are two similar situations known that do not end with collapse. a) there are multiple trainable convolutional kernels in a layer in standard convolutional neural networks where the kernels do not collapse into the same state regardless of whether they process the same input data; b) identically structured multi-paths known from ResNeXt [ 46 ] that process the same input and are aggregated at their end; here, the scheme is functional as well without its collapsing. The necessary condition is random initialization, and the desired behavior is forced by the fact that the diverse filters (paths) decrease the loss function more compared to the collapsed state. Both of these schemes are similar to ours, and thus, by indirect induction, the threat of collapsing into the same network can be refused. Practically, virtual networks inside VNNE will collapse into the same state only when all virtual networks are initialized equally. The probability of such a state is ( v ​ p b ) − 1 (vp^{b})^{-1} , i.e., 2.4 ⋅ 10 − 5 2.4\cdot 10^{-5} considering ResNet, two physical and 20 virtual neural networks

blocks.en: 2.6 Virtualization of existing architectures
blocks.zh: 2.6 现有架构的虚拟化

blocks.en: The major architectures are already split into blocks. Therefore, it is natural to make combinations on the level of blocks instead of layers. This allows us to preserve interconected elements such as batch normalization and its input. Selecting properly the division of architecture into blocks is a challenging task, unless provided explicitly by the architecture itself.
blocks.zh: 主要建筑已经被分割成块. 因此,在区块的级别上而不是在地层上进行组合是自然的. 这使我们能保留诸如批量正常化及其投入等相互交织的要素。 正确选择将建筑分割成块是一项具有挑战性的任务,除非建筑本身明确提供.

blocks.en: The ResNet architecture, regardless of the specific size, is built on repetitive convolutional residual blocks - see Table 1 in [ 47 ] . To avoid affecting the residual connections, each residual block (in the sense of ResNet architecture) is taken as a single block in the meaning of virtual network architecture. However, it is possible to construct a single virtual-network-block from multiple residual-blocks (e.g., for every repetition or the whole same-resolution-set). The input and output layers are taken as specific virtual-network-blocks. In our case, ResNet architectures are split into 11 blocks, giving us 2048 unique combinations of particular virtual networks.
blocks.zh: ResNet架构无论具体大小,都是建立在重复的轮廓残块上——见[47]中的表1. 为了避免影响剩余连接,每个剩余块(ResNet架构意义上的剩余块)都被视为虚拟网络架构意义上的单一块. 然而,从多个剩余区块(例如,每次重复或整个相同分辨率设定)中构建一个单一的虚拟网络区块是可能的. 输入层和输出层作为特定的虚拟网络块. 就我们来说,ResNet架构被分成11个块, 给我们2048个独特的组合 特定的虚拟网络。

blocks.en: The EfficientNet architecture can be divided into the initial block, called stem – performing input rescaling, normalization, padding, convolution, batch normalization, and activation; the middle part, and the final block, called top – performing final convolution, batch normalization, and activation. The middle part of EfficientNet, regardless of the EfficientNet type, consists of seven modules with different complexity with respect to the EfficientNet type. These inner blocks are typically referred as MBConvX blocks (see Table 1 in [ 48 ] ). Therefore, our approach considers the stem as one virtual-network-block, every MBConv block as one virtual-network-block, and the top blocks as another virtual-network-block – nine blocks in total regardless of the EfficientNet type, giving us 512 unique combinations of particular virtual networks.
blocks.zh: 高效网络架构可分为初始块,称为“干 ” — — 执行输入的缩放、正常化、贴补、演化、批量正常化和激活;中间部分和最终块,称为顶部 — — 执行最后演化、批量正常化和激活。 效率网的中间部分,不论效率网类型如何,都由七个与效率网类型不同的复杂模块组成. 这些内部区块通常称为MBConvX区块(见[48]中的表1)。 因此,我们的方法认为这个干线是一个虚拟-网络-块,每个MBConv块是一个虚拟-网络-块,而顶部块则是另一个虚拟-网络-块,不管效率网类型如何,总共是9个块,给我们提供了512个特定虚拟网络的独特组合。

blocks.en: 3 Benchmark
blocks.zh: 3 基准

blocks.en: We involve three datasets: CIFAR-10 [ 49 ] (Tables 1 , 4 and Fig. 5 ), CIFAR-100-LT [ 50 ] (Table 5 and Fig. 5 ), and ImageNet [ 51 ] (Fig. 4 ) in which various settings of VNNE are trained. The goal of the benchmark is not to establish a new SOTA or to perfectly replicate the best reported results, but to compare the baseline with VNNE for the same training settings.
blocks.zh: 我们涉及三个数据集:CIFAR-10[49](表1、4和图5),CIFAR-100-LT[50](表5和图5),以及培训VNNE各种环境的ImageNet[51](图4)。 基准的目标不是建立一个新的SOTA或完美地复制报告的最佳结果,而是将基准与VNNE进行相同培训环境的比较.

blocks.en: CIFAR-10: We use the standard train/test split. As a baseline, we used ResNet [ 47 ] and EfficientNet [ 48 ] , where for EfficientNet we upscaled the images to the native resolution of the models (see [ 48 ] ). The models are trained for 200 epochs, batch size 50 (ResNet models) or 16 (EfficientNet models), Adam optimizer [ 52 ] with α = 0.001 \alpha=0.001 and its decrease by factor 10 at epochs 120, 160, and 185. VNNEs are constructed with ω = 0.15 \omega=0.15 which was determined by the Optuna [ 53 ] hyperparameter search, see more in Section 4 . Masksembles ResNet [ 32 ] is trained for five virtual networks and overlapped with degree 2. As data augmentation, we use shifts and flips. The training was performed on the A-100 and inference on RTX-3090 graphics cards. To evaluate the diversity of the models in the ensemble, we measured the diversity disagreement ( d d ​ i ​ s d_{dis} ) and the Kullback-Leibler diversity ( d K ​ L d_{KL} ); for detailed definitions, see [ 34 ] . The greater the diversity, the better. For single VNNE (for both 2/10 and 2/20 settings), we measured the divergence of inner virtual networks; for their ensemble, we measured the divergence of aggregated outputs. We also evaluated particular virtual networks in VNNE and selected the best one. In the tables, it is notated as the “best single”. We can take a single virtual network from the ensemble and use it standalone as a standard model owing to the utilization of a simple aggregation layer without trainable parameters.

blocks.en: The overall results show the following: • VNNE reaches a higher test accuracy than the baseline. The accuracy of a VNNE is higher than that of a heavier baseline with more trainable parameters than a VNNE has. • The best single particular virtual network extracted from VNNE has higher accuracy than the baseline and even higher accuracy than the heavier baselines that have more trainable parameters. • To obtain an accuracy comparable to that of a VNNE with two physical networks, a standard deep ensemble of four models must be established. Moreover, VNNEs can be ensembled as well. • Compared to Masksembles and standard deep ensembles, VNNEs have a lower disagreement diversity and a higher Kullback-Leibler diversity. Taking into account the precision, it means that VNNEs are less over-confident in wrong predictions than the other approaches. This leads to the final conclusion. VNNEs are suitable for applications where accuracy is crucial and where model size is more important than processing speed.

blocks.en: Scalability. The graph in Figure 6 presents a key result: the scalability of virtual capacity. blocks.en: 5.2 Diversity loss

blocks.en: Motivated by [ 21 ] , we involved diversity loss in our compound loss, Eq. ( 2 ), but the model was stacked with accuracy equal to random selection and could not be trained. The requirement of diversity prevents particular virtual networks from producing the correct prediction. In our case, all partial virtual networks are trained simultaneously, and diversity arises naturally (see Table 1 ) when it is needed. In other words,instead of forcing partial networks (i.e., bring external bias) to yield high diversity and hope to high ensemble score, relying on inductive bias and focus on the ensemble score itself is more effective.

blocks.en: 5.3 Continuous replacement of non-promising inner networks
blocks.zh: 5.3 不断更换无希望的内部网络

blocks.en:
The performance of individual virtual neural networks within the ensemble was analyzed, revealing that their accuracies were not consistent. Consequently, training was conducted with a restarted learning rate, followed by VNNE recompilation every 200 epochs. Prior to each recompilation, the two virtual networks with the highest training loss were replaced.
For training, the same settings as described in Section 3 were used. Figure 9 shows an illustration of such a process with two restarts of the learning rate and the removal of two worst subnetworks. Since the proposed scheme did not enhance the overall performance of VNNE, it is assumed that even subnetworks with lower performance contribute to the ensemble and remain useful.

blocks.en: 5.4 Application to Transformer-based architectures
blocks.zh: 5.4 对基于变形器的架构的应用

blocks.en: The proposed virtualization scheme requires a split architecture into blocks and their fusion strategy. The first point is fulfilled by many transformer-based architectures as Swin, Eva, MaxVit etc. Regarding the second requirement, there is no theoretical justification that adding/multiplication of output from various transformer blocks will work, and deeper research, which is beyond the focus of our paper, is necessary.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
A new paradigm has been introduced that scales computational cost while maintaining a fixed model capacity. This paradigm is based on a novel ensembling approach, where a large number of tangled siamese networks share the weights of a few physical models. The tangled structure facilitates an intrinsic form of combination and distortion, leading to higher accuracy compared to both the baseline model and the deep ensemble principle.
An important property of VNNE is that it functions not only as an ensemble but also as a method for improving model training. Experimental results demonstrate that the best single model from VNNE outperforms models trained using conventional methods and even surpasses models with larger capacity. This effect is particularly pronounced in small models, whereas medium to large models show a lower or negligible improvement. While the performance boost may be relatively small, the key observation is that the best single model from VNNE consistently achieves higher accuracy than the best model trained using standard techniques. This holds even when the VNNE-trained model is compared to standard versions with greater capacity.
blocks.zh:
采用了一种新的模式,在计算成本的同时维持固定模型能力。 这个范式是基于一种新颖的综艺方法,大量缠绕的暹罗网络分享了少数物理模型的权重. 缠绕的结构有利于一种内在的组合和扭曲形式,导致与基线模型和深聚原理相比,精度更高.
VNNE的一个重要财产是,它不仅作为一个综艺节目,而且作为一个改进模式培训的方法发挥作用. 实验结果表明,来自VNNE的最佳单一模型超过了使用传统方法培训的模型,甚至超过了容量较大的模型。 这种效应在小型模型中特别明显,而中大型模型则显示改进程度较低或微不足道。 虽然性能提振可能相对较小,但关键观察是来自VNNE的最佳单一型号的精度始终高于使用标准技术培训的最佳型号. 即使将VNNE训练的模型与容量较大的标准版本进行比较,这种情况仍然存在。
